title: Ridgeline Consumer Credit Special Financing Offers at the Register
content:
Special financing on Ridgeline Consumer Credit is offered tier by tier. A plan is offered on a tier only where the table marks it available, and a single purchase qualifies only at or above the minimum shown. Amounts in USD.

| Offer | Card Classic | Card Preferred | Card Premier | Project Loan 66 | Project Loan 78 | Project Loan 84 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 6-month deferred interest — offered | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No | No |
| 6-month deferred interest — minimum single purchase | 299.00 | 299.00 | 299.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| 12-month deferred interest — offered | No | Yes | Yes | No | No | No |
| 12-month deferred interest — minimum single purchase | 0.00 | 999.00 | 999.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| 24-month deferred interest — offered | No | No | Yes | No | No | No |
| 24-month deferred interest — minimum single purchase | 0.00 | 0.00 | 2499.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| 84 fixed monthly payments at reduced APR — offered | No | Yes | Yes | No | No | No |
| 84 fixed monthly payments — minimum single purchase | 0.00 | 2000.00 | 2000.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| 84 fixed monthly payments — reduced APR (percent per year) | 0.00 | 7.99 | 7.99 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Everyday discount at the register (percent) | 5.0 | 5.0 | 5.0 | 0.0 | 0.0 | 0.0 |
| Everyday discount combinable with special financing | No | No | No | No | No | No |
| Billing cycles before a promotion ends in which excess payment goes to that promotion | 2 | 2 | 2 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

A 0.00 minimum appears only where the plan is not offered. The everyday discount is the instant discount taken at the register on a purchase charged to the card when no special financing is chosen; on no tier may it be combined with special financing on the same purchase.

## Hypothetical purchases (illustrative amounts)

| Tier | Single purchase | Plans the purchase qualifies for |
|---|---|---|
| Card Classic | 1200.00 | 6-month deferred interest |
| Card Preferred | 1200.00 | 6-month and 12-month deferred interest |
| Card Preferred | 2000.00 | 6-month, 12-month, 84 fixed payments |
| Card Premier | 2499.00 | 6-month, 12-month, 24-month, 84 fixed payments |
| Card Premier | 250.00 | none (below 299.00) |
